description: TikTok API: Get a TikTok transcript. The transcript of a video from the captions TikTok shows (`source`: asr for TikTok's auto-captions, creator, translation), as timed segments and plain text, with the caption languages available. A video without captions answers 404 (not billed). Price: 2 credits per call; failed calls are free.

lang.description: Caption language (`en` or `en-US`); default: the video's first caption track

name: tiktok_video_transcript
title: Get a TikTok transcript
